archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted for Indian B2B trust)

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-950
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

surfaces.dashboard_card: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

marketing.strategy: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Use bento grid (Mode A) for features. Large typography, overlapping elements.
marketing.button: bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-700 text-white font-bold py-4 px-8 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-orange-500/25 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
marketing.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a subtle editorial ribbon of trusted partner names.

app_and_admin.strategy: Shadcn UI, highly customized. Use 'Control Room' grid (Mode B) for dashboard. Flat rectangular style with subtle rounded corners (8px).
app_and_admin.sidebar: bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 with active states in white/orange.
app_and_admin.video_player: border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative bg-black
app_and_admin.chat_panel: border-l border-slate-200 bg-white flex flex-col h-full

image_urls.description: Indian business owner in a store (arms crossed), representing the target audience.
Woman in warehouse taking notes, excellent for the 'inventory/management' module illustration.
Abstract performance analytics dashboard on a screen, useful for admin panel empty states or feature mockups.
Sleek futuristic digital interface, can be used as a subtle background pattern for the video player container.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_strategy: High contrast APCA compliance. Deep navy on white backgrounds. Orange CTA must have white text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='start-demo-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use generic SaaS purple/teal. Stick to the Saffron/Orange (primary) and Deep Navy (secondary) palette.
For the marketing page, use custom HTML/Tailwind with generous padding (p-8 to p-16) and avoid Shadcn structural components.
For the admin panel and onboarding quiz, use Shadcn components extensively.
Ensure the video demo player has a robust overlay system (absolute positioned elements inside a relative wrapper) for the cursor, highlights, and AI chat panel.
Update Tailwind config with the provided colors to ensure variables match.
